All four admin tabs (overview/reports/approvals/bans) load; bans has ban-ip-input + ban-reason-input + add-ban-btn. HOWEVER the green 'You're listed as available crew' banner + the remove-listing-btn (trash) DO NOT render after save (see 'rca of the issue'). Note: seed_rigging (originally suggested as 'non-premium' in the request) is actually subscription_tier='featured' — the backend returns can_list_yourself=true for that tier so it correctly gets the premium UI, not the upsell. Regression: Hub filters (all/feed/forum/blog/sailing/volunteer/crew) all render; Crew Bank open-events section shows 'RCYC - Long Distance Race'; admin reports/approvals/bans tabs load; reactions on detail views still work.

ui_bugs.issue: After a premium user saves a self-listing, the green 'You're listed as available crew' card (and remove-listing-btn trash icon) never appears — the empty 'List yourself as available crew' CTA keeps showing. The listing itself IS saved (visible in 'Sailors available for crew' with the 'You' badge) and can be edited via the header list-myself-btn, but there is no UI-visible confirmation and no way to remove the listing from the UI.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/crew-bank/standalone/mine returns {"entry": {...}} (wrapped), but mobile/app/crew-bank.tsx line 35-40 does `const m = await api.get(...); setMine(m && m.user_id ? m : null);` — since m.user_id is undefined (it's actually m.entry.user_id) `mine` is always null even when a listing exists.

action_items: Fix /app/mobile/app/crew-bank.tsx line 32-40: unwrap the /crew-bank/standalone/mine response — replace `const m = await api.get("/crew-bank/standalone/mine").catch(...)` + `setMine(m && m.user_id ? m : null)` with something like `const m = await api.get<{entry:any}>("/crew-bank/standalone/mine").catch(() => null); setMine(m?.entry?.user_id ? m.entry : null);`. Then the 'You're listed as available crew' card and the trash remove-listing-btn will render correctly, and the ListingForm will receive `existing` and pre-populate the pills/inputs on edit.

OPTIONAL: consider whether subscription_tier='featured' Boat Pros should really see the premium self-listing UI (backend returns can_list_yourself=true for them). If the intent is strictly premium-only, tighten /api/crew-bank/standalone GET's can_list_yourself flag.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx correctly reads ?ref=<handle> from useSearchParams and appends `referred_by` to the /api/auth/register payload — verified end-to-end in this run.

mobile/app/(tabs)/feed.tsx: reactable = ['post','forum','blog'].includes(item._kind) — crew_open / crew_standalone are correctly excluded from reaction counts on the Hub. Batch call POST /api/reactions/batch is fire-and-forget with `.catch(() => {})` — a network error silently shows zeros. Fine for now.
mobile/app/admin.tsx Overview correctly loads /admin/analytics and /admin/referrals in parallel, and the admin-referrals section only renders when there is data (top or recent) — good.

mobile/app/crew-bank.tsx line 40 is the /standalone/mine unwrap bug (see action_items). Everything else in that file — form submit, ListingForm useEffect resetting state on visible change, upsell branch — is correct.

mobile/app/crew-bank.tsx ListingForm useEffect deps only include `visible`, missing existing/defaultMarket in the deps array — technically fine because we only want to reset on open, but ESLint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps would warn. Not a blocker.

rca of the issue: BUG: Premium user crew self-listing UI does not reflect saved state. Reproduction: (1) mint a session for seed_marina, (2) navigate to /crew-bank, (3) tap list-myself-cta, (4) pick pos-Pit + pos-Helm + mk-Greater Seattle, tap save-listing-btn — API returns 200 and the entry appears in 'Sailors available for crew' with a 'You' badge, but the top of the page still shows the empty 'List yourself as available crew' CTA (list-myself-cta) instead of the green 'You're listed as available crew' banner with remove-listing-btn. Root cause: `/api/crew-bank/standalone/mine` returns `{"entry": {...user_id, positions, ...}}` (verified via curl), but /app/mobile/app/crew-bank.tsx line 35-40 does `const m = await api.get("/crew-bank/standalone/mine").catch(() => null); setMine(m && m.user_id ? m : null);`. Since m.user_id is undefined (the actual field is m.entry.user_id), setMine(null) is called and the {mine ? ... : canList ? cta : upsell} ternary always falls to the CTA branch. Mitigation: change to `setMine(m?.entry?.user_id ? m.entry : null)` — one-line fix in crew-bank.tsx line 40 (and the type annotation on line 35).
